acceptance: In the Open Knowledge MDX dialect a capitalised component opened at a line start runs to its root close across blank lines and around fenced code (component text inside a fence never closes it), and owns every line it covers: HTML never claims a `<Tabs>` or `<Tab>` line inside it, so the product's own indented, blank-line-separated Tabs is one plan and one widget, and Markdown after the close is independent. `<Tabs>` holding only paired `<Tab label="…">` children (one quoted literal label, no expressions, spreads or repeats) renders as tabs; an unknown component, root props, expression, spread, extra, duplicate or unquoted props, a self-closing or non-Tab child, direct text, an empty Tabs, more than 64 tabs, a mismatched close, text after the close or an unclosed component stays source over every line, with its stable `mdx-component.*` code. Lowercase tags stay HTML, adjacent components stay separate, Puppy GFM has no component and no HTML widget for it, and the real-world regression document mounts exactly a table and a Tabs. A tab shows by pointer without changing the source, labels are their literal text, and after an edit above the block its source toggle reveals the component where it is now.

reason: TS mounts each tab as a focusable button with a roving tabindex and switches tabs with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End while a tab has focus. The native Tabs widget's labels are pointer targets only: block widgets have no focus of their own, so the tab bar cannot be reached or switched from the keyboard.
